title: At the Cafe
text:
Anna goes to a small cafe with her friend. The menu has many good things to eat. There is soup, bread, and salad. Anna wants a sandwich and a glass of juice.

Her friend wants pizza. The pizza is hot and costs five dollars. They also order two cups of tea. The waiter brings the food quickly.

questions.text: What does Anna want to eat?
What can we guess about the food at the cafe?
options: It is probably fresh and good
It is probably not on the menu

questions.text: What is the best guess about Anna and her friend?
options: They are hungry and want to eat
They are tired and want to sleep
They are cold and want to swim

vocabulary.definition: a list of food and drinks in a cafe or restaurant
bread with food between two slices
a person who serves food in a cafe or restaurant
to ask for food or drink to be brought

paragraph_translations: Анна йде до маленької кав'ярні зі своєю подругою. У меню багато смачної їжі. Є суп, хліб і салат. Анна хоче бутерброд і склянку соку.
Її подруга хоче піцу. Піца гаряча і коштує п'ять доларів. Вони також замовляють дві чашки чаю. Офіціант приносить їжу швидко.
